extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / new editors attempting to create a new article (or locate an existing one)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors trying to create or find a Wikipedia article (here: 'John Vorhaus'), including account requirements, search steps, and troubleshooting for missing or deleted pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account / autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create an article directly because you are not autoconfirmed, use the article wizard to submit a draft or request a new article for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For editors who cannot create live articles, submit a draft via the wizard or make a request so experienced editors can assist with creation and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles and alternative spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "John Vorhaus" in existing articles. Look for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check for existing coverage under variant spellings, alternative titles, or redirects to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to discover related content or the canonical page; linked pages can indicate where content about the subject already exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge option
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an expected newly-created page does not appear, either wait briefly for database updates or use the purge function to refresh page caches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn whether the page was removed and the reason; use that information to decide whether to revise and request recreation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants (first-letter and other letters) and, if appropriate, create or request a redirect from alternate spellings or capitalizations to the canonical page.
